vb_textbox.text: Which of the two choices is better keeps changing through the game. If you get values below 3 for a colour, choose the other one for a while until that one drops. For a little while in the middle it seemed like all choices were bad, but after a bit I got higher numbers again. For me, brown and green were consistently better than red and purple - except for a few intervals, but this might be randomised and you might have different colours be the best options. If one colour has very high numbers (8-9) it seemed like the other one had very lows, but sometimes they were both in the middle (4-5). The time taken to click space when collecting the mushrooms did not seem to have an impact on the number of mushrooms. There also did not seem to be a pattern for alternating colours or sides to improve numbers, so colours seemed to be the most important factor to predict numbers.
